selection.rule: Same metadata-only selection, exclude all N1/N2/N6/N7/N8/N9 and historical/R40H/R37/R40CDE targets, days, sky and raw source hashes including N5A bank/replay; four fresh Parkes groups, minimum two, otherwise HOLD. Freeze manifest before any new power; freeze model before fresh reads.

same_receiver.rule: Re-query exact base and _S/_R aliases from full old 237-candidate ledger and current archive index. Deterministic priority: previously candidate cadence then all other names. Detailed gate labels replacing unlabeled assertions; original strict 16 rows, expected source, frequency, time, WCS and pointing gates unchanged; exact N6 native resolution/time match. No power until both manifests frozen.

uwl.rule: Separately report Parkes UWL subband transfer (receiver, native cadence/frequency differences; no pooled same-receiver conclusion). Query metadata-only 22 published TIC systems excluding corrupt TIC 251852984, additional TIC aliases from index, explicit _S/_R, published dates not selection by event results. Four native windows 2850/3050/3250/3330 MHz; high-resolution HDF5, matching headers, same physical scan per four subbands, exactly four alternating ON/OFF independent scans in same cadence, actual source and pointing and signed WCS checked. At least 16 native integrations, first 16 consecutive original rows with no resampling, record original nrows/df/ts; only Stokes/total-intensity one IF, no polarization mixing. Header-based timing, metadata MJD rounding <=5 sec; same sky exclusion and same-day disjointness across lanes. Fail closed if missing subband or incompatible metadata. Predeclare fixed one-file-per-window selection, no power-based replacement. Use old N10 model, no fit or cutoff changes, score same bin/time template as a transfer test.

published_uwl.note: Published study describes 25 sessions, 3650 HDF5 files, but availability/qualification of particular files is unverified; use only public source metadata, not published signal labels.

independence: All pinned historical manifests, N1/N2/N6/N7/N8/N9 and N10 864 excluded native hashes, target aliases, days, files, sky guard 0.1 deg. Metadata-only freeze before power. No use of previously assessed 3I/ATLAS data; explicitly exclude ATLAS variants. Separate lane gates require >=2 qualified and acquired groups; no pooled results; count failed acquisitions as HOLD for entire lane, do not replace after exposure.
model: Exact authenticated N10 lock reused byte-for-byte, no training, no threshold selection, parent N7/N8/N9 frozen and unchanged. Test all 24 N10 variants descriptively; no external exam. Use N10 measure and exact Turbo parity. Same synthetic injection and stationary repeat stress, native recorded backgrounds. Gate zero paired ordinary/shared/weak/stress losses, at least one stress case, controls <=35/640 and <=7/8 Learned05. Retain per-group artifacts, source hashes, metadata rejection ledger. Production R28 unchanged.
